project_type: Go backend + Angular frontend monorepo for vulnerability tracking
test_framework: Go testing with httptest mocks (backend), Angular test (frontend)
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/mayu && go build ./... && cd ui && pnpm install && pnpm build
verification_instructions: 1. Run go build ./... from project root 2. Run go test ./internal/server/ 3. Run pnpm install && pnpm build in ui/
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/mayu && go build ./... 2. cd ui && pnpm install
environment_constraints: Open internet available for installing dependencies
contribution_requirements: No specific constraints found affecting this task
key_patterns: - buildOrderClause(sort, prefix) handles ORDER BY generation, prefix is 'v.' for searchLight and '' for Search. Both paths already JOIN vulnerability_summary as 'vs'. - Frontend uses Angular standalone components with inline templates, Tailwind CSS with dark: prefix, FormsModule with ngModel, i18n attributes for localization. - Sort select currently has 4 options: modified_desc, modified_asc, published_desc, published_asc. - FilterState interface groups all filter state, emptyFilters() provides defaults.
relevant_files: cmd/mayu/search.go (line ~32: CLI sort flag help text)
directory_structure: cmd/mayu/ - CLI entry points, internal/server/ - HTTP server with chi router, internal/store/ - PostgreSQL data layer, internal/model/ - domain models, ui/src/app/ - Angular app with pages/, models/, services/, shared/
